meaning:
1) head, poll, skull
1a) skull
1b) head, poll (of census)

elsewhere.note: “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you…
“Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every…
A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.
They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.
They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
